query:
SELECT latest.trigger as "trigger!", latest.runnable_path as "runnable_path!",
                  COALESCE(jc.status::text, 'running') as "status!"
           FROM (
               SELECT DISTINCT ON (trigger, runnable_path) id, trigger, runnable_path
               FROM v2_job
               WHERE workspace_id = $1
                 AND trigger_kind = 'ci_test'
                 AND trigger IS NOT NULL
                 AND runnable_path IS NOT NULL
                 AND created_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $2)
                 AND EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM script s
                     WHERE s.workspace_id = $1
                       AND s.path = v2_job.runnable_path
                       AND NOT s.deleted AND NOT s.archived
                 )
               ORDER BY trigger, runnable_path, created_at DESC
           ) latest
           LEFT JOIN v2_job_completed jc ON jc.id = latest.id
